# Verify all contacts are now friends
all_friends_after = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_login['access_token'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)

    all_friends_after.extend(page)
